extracted.intended_audience: current and prospective Verve credit union members and consumers seeking banking products or basic financial education
extracted.subtask_description: A corporate product/marketing page describing Verve Credit Union's checking, savings, loans, cards, bundles, and Financial Resource Center content and disclosures. It presents product bundles, short financial lessons, and standard consumer disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobile-friendly, self-guided financial lessons
rubrics_metrics.description: “unlimited access to mobile-friendly, self-guided financial lessons.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a core feature of the Financial Resource Center; described along with a robust library of 30+ learning topics and positioned as accessible regardless of life stage or financial circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Library size / topical breadth
rubrics_metrics.description: “Our robust library of 30+ learning topics has something for everyone, regardless of your life stage or financial circumstances.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied expectation that the resource center covers a broad set of foundational financial topics (30+) to serve diverse members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lesson length guideline (3–6 minutes)
rubrics_metrics.description: “essential information for each learning topic can be consumed in just 3-6 minutes to fit into today’s busy lifestyle.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets an editorial/format constraint for lessons: content should be concise and digestible in short time blocks to increase accessibility and completion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language availability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies linguistic accessibility requirement for the courses (at least English and Spanish).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of a short quiz to personalize learning
rubrics_metrics.description: “If you’re not sure where to start, you can take a short quiz to help you determine which playlists will best help you achieve your financial goals.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommends an assessment-driven onboarding flow (short quiz) to tailor recommended lesson playlists to the user’s goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bundle presentation and composition
rubrics_metrics.description: Bundles described as groups of products (Optimum, Premier, Essential+, Essential) listing included accounts and cards (e.g., Verve Optimum Checking, Verve Optimum Money Market, Verve Optimum World Mastercard®).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each bundle is framed by a goal (optimize earnings; rebuild stability; plan for life steps; build a foundation) and includes which specific products are part of that bundle; messaging emphasizes saving and lower fees when bundling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising disclosure for Verve Premier Mastercard®
rubrics_metrics.description: “*APR = Annual Percentage Rate. 0% Introductory APR on all purchases and balance transfers for 12 billing cycles from the date of account opening. After that, as of January 1, 2026, your Standard APR will be 11.65% to 20.65% depending on your credit history. This APR will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. A Balance Transfer fee of 3.00% of the amount of each transfer or $5.00, whichever is greater will apply. No annual fee.  Consult a Verve team member for an application. Membership eligibility required.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes required regulatory/consumer-disclosure elements for the card offer: intro APR terms, post-intro APR range, fee schedule for balance transfers, annual fee statement, application and membership eligibility notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory / compliance notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements such as “Federally Insured by NCUA | Equal Housing Opportunity | Legal + Disclosures” and inclusion of NMLS number and routing number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard compliance badges and identifiers required on consumer-facing financial pages to signal insurance, fair housing compliance, and regulatory registration.
